title: Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India
body_text:
UPSC invites applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment to various posts in Government of India.
The detailed Advertisement No. 10/2026 , along-with instructions to the candidates has been uploaded on the Commission’s website https://upsc.gov.in . Interested candidates can apply through the Online Recruitment Application portal https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/ from 8th August, 2026 to 28th August, 2026 (for posts other than those under the administration of UT of Ladakh) and 4th September, 2026 (for posts under the administration of UT of Ladakh).
Candidates are requested to follow the detailed instructions mentioned therein.
***
NKR/AV

enrichment.summary: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has invited applications for direct recruitment to various posts in the Government of India under Advertisement No. 10/2026. The detailed advertisement and application instructions are available on the UPSC website, and candidates can apply online via the ORA portal from 8th to 28th August 2026, with an extended deadline of 4th September 2026 for posts under the UT of Ladakh.
enrichment.context: UPSC periodically issues advertisements for direct recruitment to various Group A and Group B posts in central government ministries and departments, distinct from its major examinations like the Civil Services Examination. This is a routine administrative notification informing prospective candidates of application windows and procedures via the Online Recruitment Application (ORA) portal.
